title: Incorrect `activateBoost` interface is used
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In Staker contract, we will activate our queued boost BGT. The interface we use is as below:  ```solidity     function activateBoost(address validator) external; ```  ```solidity     function _tryToBoost() internal {         if (queued > 0 && blockDelta > 8191) {             rewardCache.activateBoost(validator);         }     } ```  When we check the BGT's implementation, we will find out that the correct interface should be like as below:  ```solidity     function activateBoost(address user, bytes calldata pubkey) external
